files.what: Key figure: (a) Poiseuille centreline u(y) vs the analytic parabola with the 2 % L2 pass band (gate 3), (b) cavity centreline u/v vs Ghia et al. 1982 (gate 5), (c) mesh-convergence log-log with fitted order vs the order >= 1.5 gate (gate 4), (d) cavity |U| at t = 30 s.
The agent loop, replayed: the gate-5 metric per replayed iteration (each iteration fixes the gate the previous one failed) plus the self-test kill-rate bar for all 10 mutants.
Cavity flow developing over pseudo-time: |U| field from the saved time directories of a real icoFoam run, with the gate-2 residual convergence; lossless crf 0 master in git-ignored media/master/.
